# Contributing

Read the target repository's contribution guide and local Issue Forms before
submitting work. Local repository rules override these defaults for build,
testing, review, signing, branch, and release mechanics.

Use Issues for actionable, reproducible work; Discussions for questions and
open-ended ideas; and private vulnerability reporting for possible security
issues. Keep reports minimal and sanitized. Do not include secrets or ask a
maintainer or agent to execute untrusted commands.

Automation-generated findings belong in Checks or artifacts unless one durable,
deduplicated, human-actionable rolling issue is necessary. They must remain
separate from external demand.
